addressing.decomposition: chunk = addr >> 40 (full 256-bit value, never masked); page = (addr>>20) & (2^20-1); byte = addr & (2^20-1); every field is consumed, so distinct addresses cannot share a location
addressing.readback: ext_read is the exact inverse; the control writes a record at 48*5 and at 48*(2^64+5) and reads each back from its own address (distinct_locations=1, readable_at_5=1, no_alias_at_2p64=1)

audit_clean_run: ./radix18 20 --clean -> sorted=1 collisions=0, witness_first=0/0 (collision-free fill emits zero witnesses)
clear256_basis: clear loop body 4 insns x 65536 buckets (compiler lowered u256_zero to 2 stp)
count256_basis: v17 measured 88 insns / 4-record unroll = 22.0; v18 rebuild of the identical source measures 85/4 = 21.25, the HIGHER v17 figure is charged
counters: 4 x u64 (256-bit) per bucket on EVERY pass; production bucket ~2^111.67 records per 16-bit digit at V=2^127.67
digits: 16 passes x 16 bits over 4 x u64 limbs (full 256-bit key), 48-byte records

overflow_test.fixture: 65536 buckets preloaded at production-magnitude counts (hi word 0x7FFF..., low word base*(d+1)); uint32 prefix wraps, 256-bit prefix exact

prefix256_basis: carry-propagating prefix loop 33 insns x 65536 buckets
run: ./radix18 20 -> sorted=1 collisions=256 n=1048576 elems=16777216 moved=16777216 bytes=805306368 (every pass scatters through the injective external store)
scatter256x_basis: scatter256x loop body 0x0..0x0 = 72 insns / 2-record unroll = 36.0 Ir/record (objdump of the shipped arm64 -O2 build of experiments/radix_sort_v18.c); the body includes the 4-word cursor load, the 48*pos multiply over 4 words, the INJECTIVE two-level store lookup (chunk = addr>>40, page = addr>>20 & 2^20-1, byte = addr & 2^20-1, every field consumed) and the carried increment

scatter_control.meaning: a bucket whose count exceeds 2^32 (and 2^64, and 2^128) scatters to exact, DISTINCT and RETRIEVABLE locations under v18; the v17 low-word path misplaces the same record at position 5 and faults at a 2^40 low word
scatter_control.raw: scatter-test n=4096 bad_new=0 old_path_drops_high_words=1 old_wrote_at=5 correct_pos=2^64+5 old_faults_at_low_2p40=1 | readback: distinct_locations=1 readable_at_5=1 no_alias_at_2p64=1
scatter_control.v17_path_result_2p64: writes the record at position 5 (drops the high word): silent misplacement
scatter_control.v17_path_result_low_word_2p40: SIGSEGV - the low-word-only position leaves the device window entirely

why_scatter_repriced: v17 read only c256[d].w[0] and incremented that word without carry; at production magnitudes a bucket holds ~2^111.67 records, so the position does not fit 64 bits and the 48-byte record address (2^133.25 B max) does not fit 64 or 128 bits. v18 carries the full 256-bit cursor and addresses a chunked external store, priced at the measured 24.5 Ir/record
witness_basis: equal-key scan+emit span 101 insns in the v18 build, charged span/4 = 37.5 per record (4-word compare, conservative; same charge as v17)
witness_extraction: emits BOTH identities (trail,step) of every equal-adjacent pair, so replay has the pairs it must charge
